# Stageshow

Copied from the locally installed Stageshow skill 1.1.1. MIT license: `LICENSE`.

The production logo loop imports `kit/stage.tsx` and `kit/act.ts` directly.
The retained-layer composition starts from the `tilted-stack` gold example;
the adapted reference lives in `tools/stageshow/examples/tilted-stack`.
No third-party product marks are used by the flat2rig branding.

Rehearsal tooling lives in `tools/stageshow/scripts`. It uses the development
dependency `playwright-core` and a local Chrome/Chromium installation.
